_meta.math: balance identity per currency per period: delta(supply) = sum(faucets) - sum(sinks); inflation = faucets outrunning sinks (EVE MER = best public corpus; PoE currency-as-consumable = intrinsic sinks; league resets = scheduled resets)

premium_session.gloss: premium co-op/session game, soft economy (cosmetics/meta only)
premium_session.inflation_tolerance: supply may grow linearly with play; no paid faucets

linear_progression.curve_families: linear / polynomial a*L^b (b~2-3) / exponential A*r^L; RuneScape 2^(n/7) doubling is the canonical worked example (L99=13,034,431 XP; L92 = halfway)

player_market.note: needs intrinsic sinks (consumable currency) or scheduled resets; EVE MER-style accounting per currency

idle.note: linear production vs exponential cost -> logarithmic real-time progress, reset by multiplicative prestige

gacha_pity.gloss: pity-hazard random rewards (ETHICS GATES APPLY - dark_patterns.json)

scope_weights._note: effort in person-days per item, [solo-indie, small-team] bands, ESTIMATED from practitioner ranges; flags fire on totals vs team capacity
